text:
Sam Carter: Async check-in on Q3 throughput & cost milestone — quick status please. What actually shipped, what slipped, and immediate unblock asks?
Priya Nair: Shipped: prefix cache prototype (v1) to staging, rollout flag behind feature gate. Slipped: distributed load test harness — hit infra limits during scale tests.
Diego Alvarez: Confirm infra hit OOM during the 2k-concurrent-worker test; need tuned k8s node sizes and ephemeral GPU pool for perf runs.
Morgan Lee: PR ready for code review that wires the cache into runtime routing: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rt/+/452 — pinging reviewers @Lena Park and @Diego Alvarez.
Lena Park: On review. I'll take a pass today, focus on correctness around KV eviction semantics.
Priya Nair: For the load tests I'm going to trim the test matrix to prioritize 99th-pct latency and peak throughput scenarios, so we can at least get an SLI snapshot. Diego, can you provision 2x p4d as a smoke pool?
Diego Alvarez: Yep, will allocate 2x p4d for 6 hours tomorrow morning. ETA: provisioning script run at 08:30 UTC.
Sam Carter: OK — owners updated: cache rollout = Priya (prod flags), runtime integration = Morgan (PR), infra for load = Diego. Outcome goal for next 48h: smoke runs + reviewer signoff.
Morgan Lee: Small note: cache integration exposes a new metric 'cache.prefix_hit' — need dashboards. @Lena can you add to the per-model latency dashboard?
Lena Park: Will add a graph and a simple alert if prefix_hit < 60% for > 10m.
infra-bot: provisioning started: job_id=prov-8821, estimated_complete=1725002460
Priya Nair: If smoke passes, plan is to flip feature gate in canary only, monitor token-cost delta and 95/99 latency. I'll post the eval prompts we're using after runs.
Sam Carter: Risks: if load tests show cache thrashing we may delay broad rollout by 1 week. Mitigation: incremental canary and rollback flag is in place.
Diego Alvarez: Quick ops snippet for the smoke run (sharing for visibility):
```
# run perf driver
./perf-driver --target rt-canary --concurrency 2000 --duration 10m --metrics-endpoint http://telemetry.internal:9090
```
Morgan Lee: Reviewers: I requested @Lena and @Sam for final signoff. If no issues, I'll merge and coordinate canary deploy window.
Sam Carter: Thanks all. Action items: Diego provision (in flight), Lena dashboard + review, Morgan finish merge if green, Priya post eval set + gate flip plan. Check back here with short updates — one-line status replies appreciated. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: Status 2h — load provisioning succeeded, smoke queued.
Lena Park: Status 3h — dashboard added, doing PR review now.
Morgan Lee: Status 4h — CI green, merge queued pending canary window confirmation.
Sam Carter: Closing loop in 24h unless blockers appear. If anything slips, flag here with owner and ETA.
